mapper.select: select m.BID_ID ,m.ENTRUST_ID ,m.BID_PRICE * 100 bidPrice ,m.IS_WIN ,m.WIN_PRICE * 100 winPrice ,m.WIN_CPRICE ,m.THE_WIN_PRIN_AMT ,m.WIN_PRIN_AMT ,t.PORTFOLIO_ID ,t.PORTFOLIO_NAME ,s.BID_PRIN_AMT ,n.INV_MANAGER_ID from BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE m inner join ETR_ENTRUST n on m.ENTRUST_ID=n.ENTRUST_ID left join PTL_PORTFOLIO t on n.PORTFOLIO_ID=t.PORTFOLIO_ID left join ETR_ENTRUST_BID_PRICE s on m.ENTRUST_ID=s.ENTRUST_ID and m.BID_PRICE=s.BID_PRICE where n.FINPROD_ID=#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and n.COUNTER_ID = #{counterId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND M.BID_Id = #{bidId} and m.IS_WIN is null order by m.BID_PRICE
